purpose: Verify the complete observable behaviour specified by Manual Backup Management.
preconditions: A current BADMS database state is available. A SysAdmin or Super Admin test actor is authenticated. Backup storage and the backup execution dependency are available.
action_or_input: Trigger an on-demand backup as the authorized actor; inspect the stored backup artifact, timestamp, outcome record and failure-notification behavior.
expected_result: The on-demand backup captures and stores the current database state, records timestamped outcome information, and handles backup-failure notification as specified.

purpose: Verify the complete observable behaviour specified by Scheduled Automatic Backup Execution.
preconditions: An effective backup schedule is due, at least one eligible dataset exists, and the scheduled repository is reachable.
action_or_input: Run the scheduled backup dispatch and inspect dataset selection, transfer to recovery storage, integrity/consistency verification and recorded outcome.
expected_result: The automatic backup runs without user intervention at the effective scheduled time, processes eligible datasets, verifies integrity/consistency and records the outcome.

purpose: Verify the complete observable behaviour specified by Local Backup Schedule Management.
preconditions: A SysAdmin actor and a dataset for which a local schedule can be configured are available.
action_or_input: View the current local schedule, create or modify it with valid parameters, and inspect the applied schedule and change log.
expected_result: The authorized SysAdmin can view/create/modify the local schedule; only valid configurations are applied and schedule changes are logged.

purpose: Verify the complete observable behaviour specified by Backup Status and History Visibility.
preconditions: Backup records exist for the requesting user and for at least one other scope. Test actors have their stated scopes.
action_or_input: Request backup status/history as a user and as an authorized administrator, using records within and outside each actor’s permitted scope.
expected_result: Current backup status and history are maintained and displayed only within the requesting actor’s authorized scope.

purpose: Verify the complete observable behaviour specified by Secure Archival Submission and Intake.
preconditions: An authenticated user, required archival metadata, an attachment and a storage-quota record are available.
action_or_input: Submit a secure archival request with required metadata and an initial classification; also exercise the stated missing-classification default.
expected_result: A valid request is accepted with status Submitted and routed to the requester’s HoD; a missing initial classification defaults to Routine.

purpose: Verify the complete observable behaviour specified by Secure Archival HoD Review and Routing.
preconditions: A submitted secure archival request and the HoD for the requester’s department are available.
action_or_input: Have the respective HoD review the request and record an approval; separately exercise the rejection decision.
expected_result: The HoD decision is recorded. An approved request is routed to the SysAdmin for authoritative classification; a rejected request follows the rejection outcome.

purpose: Verify the complete observable behaviour specified by Authoritative Archival Classification and Policy Routing.
preconditions: A HoD-approved archival request and a SysAdmin actor are available.
action_or_input: Have the SysAdmin assign an authoritative classification, including a Sensitive classification case.
expected_result: The authoritative classification is assigned; the corresponding security/retention treatment is applied and Sensitive requests are routed to IT Security.

purpose: Verify the complete observable behaviour specified by Sensitive Data Encryption and Archive Creation.
preconditions: A request is authoritatively classified Sensitive and an authorized IT Security actor is available.
action_or_input: Configure encryption for the Sensitive data and inspect the archive, encryption details and recorded outcome.
expected_result: The archive is created using AES-256 encryption at rest and in transit, and the outcome is recorded.

purpose: Verify the complete observable behaviour specified by Secure Archival Tracking and Notifications.
preconditions: A secure archival request has progressed through submission and a decision stage. The requester can access the request.
action_or_input: As the requester, retrieve request status/history after submission and after an approval or rejection decision.
expected_result: The user can track the request status/history and receives the submission and decision notifications at the relevant stages.

purpose: Verify the complete observable behaviour specified by Special Archival Operation.
preconditions: An offline special-archival request has been received from an authority; Sensitive research data and Super Admin/non-Super Admin actors are available.
action_or_input: Perform the special archival operation as the Super Admin and inspect its outcome and audit event.
expected_result: Only the Super Admin performs the special archival operation for the Sensitive research data, and the outcome and audit event are recorded.

purpose: Verify the complete observable behaviour specified by Data Restoration Management.
preconditions: A non-Sensitive archive and a Sensitive archive are available, with restoration requests and a SysAdmin actor.
action_or_input: Request restoration for both classifications; approve the Sensitive request before attempting its technical restoration, and execute the non-Sensitive standard path.
expected_result: Non-Sensitive data follows the standard restoration path. Sensitive restoration proceeds only through the SysAdmin-approved path; requests and status are trackable.

purpose: Verify the complete observable behaviour specified by Storage Extension Request and Decision.
preconditions: A user has a full storage quota. Available infrastructure information, a departmental policy and the user justification are available to the HoD.
action_or_input: Submit a storage-extension request, validate current usage and infrastructure sufficiency, then have the HoD review the stated criteria and decide.
expected_result: A valid request is routed to the user’s HoD, who can review the criteria and record an approval or rejection.

purpose: Verify the complete observable behaviour specified by Storage Threshold Monitoring.
preconditions: Storage quota usage records exist for multiple users, including values on both sides of the configured threshold.
action_or_input: Run storage-threshold monitoring and inspect the maintained threshold/full-quota condition for users.
expected_result: BADMS monitors user storage thresholds and maintains the threshold/full-quota condition used by storage-management decisions.

purpose: Verify the complete observable behaviour specified by Global Backup Schedules and Defaults.
preconditions: A Super Admin can manage global policy. Datasets exist with and without a valid local schedule.
action_or_input: Define an institution-wide global schedule/default policy and resolve the effective schedule for datasets with and without valid local overrides.
expected_result: Only the Super Admin defines global schedules/defaults; global policy applies without a valid local override, while a valid local schedule takes precedence.

purpose: Verify the complete observable behaviour specified by Retention by Data Classification.
preconditions: Institute-defined retention rules are configured for the supported data classifications.
action_or_input: Evaluate retention treatment for archived data across its authoritative classifications.
expected_result: Retention is enforced according to the institute-defined rules selected by authoritative classification; no classification-specific duration is assumed where the source supplies none.

purpose: Verify the complete observable behaviour specified by Backup Failure Notification and Escalation.
preconditions: A backup can be made to fail, a SysAdmin and Director of IT notification target are configured, and consecutive backup history can be set up.
action_or_input: Mark a backup Failed, measure the alert time, then exercise three consecutive backup failures and inspect status/completion notifications.
expected_result: The SysAdmin is alerted within five minutes of failure; after three consecutive failures the condition is escalated to the Director of IT, and required backup status/completion notifications are issued.

purpose: Verify the complete observable behaviour specified by Storage-Extension Notifications.
preconditions: A requester and a storage-extension request can be created and decided by a HoD.
action_or_input: Submit the storage-extension request, then record HoD approval and rejection outcomes in separate runs; inspect requester notifications.
expected_result: The requester is notified on submission and when the HoD records either approval or rejection.

purpose: Verify the complete observable behaviour specified by Audit Logging and Operational Reporting.
preconditions: Auditable user, administrative, system and security events exist. SysAdmin, IT Security and HoD actors have defined scopes.
action_or_input: Generate representative audit events and retrieve audit/security/backup/departmental operational views using the relevant authorized roles.
expected_result: Audit events are recorded with required identifiers/outcomes and the operational views are available only to the authorized roles and scopes stated in the requirement.

purpose: Verify the complete observable behaviour specified by RBAC, Security Policy, and Role Separation.
preconditions: IT Security, HoD, SysAdmin and Super Admin test actors exist, with users and departments represented in IAM.
action_or_input: Exercise IT Security RBAC/security-policy management and attempt representative cross-role and cross-department actions.
expected_result: IT Security can manage RBAC and security policies, while HoD departmental scope and the separation of HoD, SysAdmin, Super Admin and IT Security responsibilities are enforced.

purpose: Verify the behaviour stated in AFR-BA-001.
preconditions: A valid backup target exists. A SysAdmin and a Super Admin test actor are available.
action_or_input: Trigger a manual backup once as SysAdmin and once as Super Admin.
expected_result: Both explicitly permitted roles can trigger a manual backup.

purpose: Verify the behaviour stated in AFR-BA-002.
preconditions: A manual backup can be triggered and the required backup artifacts are available.
action_or_input: Trigger a manual backup and inspect its captured timestamp and required backup artifacts.
expected_result: The system collects the current timestamp and required backup artifacts when the manual backup is triggered.

purpose: Verify the behaviour stated in AFR-BA-003.
preconditions: A database connection and a manual backup target are available.
action_or_input: Trigger a manual backup and inspect the saved dump and associated timestamp.
expected_result: The system communicates with the database and saves a current-state dump together with its timestamp.

purpose: Verify the behaviour stated in AFR-BA-004.
preconditions: Backup execution can be made to succeed and fail in separate test runs.
action_or_input: Run one successful backup and one backup that fails; inspect the recorded and communicated outcomes.
expected_result: Each backup outcome is recorded and communicated as Success or Failure.

purpose: Verify the behaviour stated in AFR-BA-005.
preconditions: The backup-creation dependency can be made unavailable or otherwise made to fail; a SysAdmin notification target exists.
action_or_input: Trigger a manual backup when backup creation cannot complete.
expected_result: The backup is marked Failed and the SysAdmin is alerted.

purpose: Verify the behaviour stated in AFR-BA-006.
preconditions: An automatic backup schedule is due and no user manually triggers the run.
action_or_input: Allow the scheduled execution mechanism to process the due schedule.
expected_result: The system performs the automatic backup at the scheduled time without user intervention.

purpose: Verify the behaviour stated in AFR-BA-007.
preconditions: An applicable schedule and datasets with eligible/ineligible status are available.
action_or_input: Run automatic backup selection for the applicable schedule.
expected_result: The system identifies and reads the datasets eligible under that schedule.

purpose: Verify the behaviour stated in AFR-BA-008.
preconditions: At least one dataset is eligible for an automatic backup and recovery storage is available.
action_or_input: Run the automatic backup and inspect the destination recovery storage.
expected_result: Eligible data is transferred to backup recovery storage during the automatic backup.

purpose: Verify the behaviour stated in AFR-BA-009.
preconditions: An automatic backup artifact is available for verification.
action_or_input: Run automatic backup integrity and consistency verification against the created artifact.
expected_result: The system verifies the integrity and consistency of the automatic backup.

purpose: Verify the behaviour stated in AFR-BA-010.
preconditions: An automatic backup has completed verification.
action_or_input: Complete an automatic backup and inspect its log record.
expected_result: The verified automatic backup is logged with its timestamp and status.

purpose: Verify the behaviour stated in AFR-BA-011.
preconditions: A scheduled repository can be configured as reachable or unreachable, and a schedule can be enabled for it.
action_or_input: Run the scheduled automatic backup with the relevant repository scheduled and reachable; then repeat with the repository unreachable.
expected_result: The scheduled automatic backup executes only when the relevant repository is scheduled and reachable.

purpose: Verify the behaviour stated in AFR-BA-012.
preconditions: A SysAdmin actor and at least one current backup schedule exist.
action_or_input: Request the current backup schedule listing as SysAdmin.
expected_result: The current backup schedules are displayed to the authorized SysAdmin.

purpose: Verify the behaviour stated in AFR-BA-013.
preconditions: A SysAdmin actor and a dataset are available for local schedule configuration.
action_or_input: Create or modify a local schedule by providing frequency, execution time and data-classification filters.
expected_result: The SysAdmin can create or modify the local backup schedule using the specified parameters.

purpose: Verify the behaviour stated in AFR-BA-014.
preconditions: An existing local backup schedule is available for comparison.
action_or_input: Submit a schedule with invalid parameters, such as an invalid schedule expression.
expected_result: The invalid schedule configuration is rejected and is not applied.

purpose: Verify the behaviour stated in AFR-BA-015.
preconditions: A valid new or updated local backup schedule is prepared.
action_or_input: Submit the valid schedule after parameter validation.
expected_result: The system applies the new or updated local backup schedule after successful validation.

purpose: Verify the behaviour stated in AFR-BA-016.
preconditions: A backup schedule can be created or modified.
action_or_input: Change a backup-schedule configuration and inspect the audit/log records.
expected_result: The system logs each backup-schedule configuration change.

purpose: Verify the behaviour stated in AFR-BA-017.
preconditions: Backup operations have been run and have recorded statuses.
action_or_input: Retrieve the maintained backup status and history.
expected_result: The system maintains the current status and history of all backup operations.

purpose: Verify the behaviour stated in AFR-BA-018.
preconditions: Backup history/status records exist for different scopes; user and authorized-administrator actors are available.
action_or_input: Request backup history and current status as a user and as an authorized administrator.
expected_result: Users and authorized administrators can view backup history and current status within the scopes granted to them.

purpose: Verify the behaviour stated in AFR-BA-019.
preconditions: An authenticated user is available and can provide secure-archival request data.
action_or_input: Initiate a secure archival request while authenticated.
expected_result: The authenticated user can initiate a secure archival request.

purpose: Verify the behaviour stated in AFR-BA-020.
preconditions: An authenticated user has file metadata and a file attachment to submit.
action_or_input: Submit a secure archival request with file name, date, owners, file type, reason and attachment.
expected_result: The request captures all listed metadata and the file attachment.

purpose: Verify the behaviour stated in AFR-BA-021.
preconditions: An archival request submission can be made invalid by omitting required request information.
action_or_input: Submit the archival request with required information missing and inspect validation feedback and request state.
expected_result: The system displays validation errors and makes no request-state change.

purpose: Verify the behaviour stated in AFR-BA-022.
preconditions: A secure archival request has passed its submission validation.
action_or_input: Submit the valid secure archival request and inspect its status.
expected_result: The secure archival request is set to Submitted.

purpose: Verify the behaviour stated in AFR-BA-023.
preconditions: A user with a known department submits a valid secure archival request; the department HoD is identifiable.
action_or_input: Submit the request and inspect its assigned review destination.
expected_result: The submitted request is routed to the HoD of the requester’s department.

purpose: Verify the behaviour stated in AFR-BA-024.
preconditions: A secure archival request is routed to its department HoD.
action_or_input: Open the routed request as that HoD and review its details, attachment and policy context.
expected_result: The HoD can review the request details, attachments and policy context before deciding.

purpose: Verify the behaviour stated in AFR-BA-025.
preconditions: A submitted secure archival request is available to its HoD.
action_or_input: Record an approval decision in one run and a rejection decision in another; inspect each decision record.
expected_result: The HoD can approve or reject the request and the selected decision is recorded.

purpose: Verify the behaviour stated in AFR-BA-026.
preconditions: A secure archival request belongs to Department A, and its own HoD belongs to Department A.
action_or_input: Have the Department A HoD approve or reject the Department A request.
expected_result: The HoD of the requester’s department is permitted to decide the secure archival request.

purpose: Verify the behaviour stated in AFR-BA-027.
preconditions: A secure archival request has been approved by its HoD; a SysAdmin is available.
action_or_input: Complete the HoD approval and inspect the next assigned review responsibility.
expected_result: The approved request is routed to the SysAdmin for classification.

purpose: Verify the behaviour stated in AFR-BA-028.
preconditions: An approved secure archival request and a SysAdmin actor are available.
action_or_input: Classify the approved data using each of the four stated values: Critical, Sensitive, Routine and Archival.
expected_result: The SysAdmin can review and assign the authoritative classification from the four stated values.

purpose: Verify the behaviour stated in AFR-BA-029.
preconditions: A user can submit archival data with and without an initial classification.
action_or_input: Submit one request with an initial classification and another with the classification omitted.
expected_result: The user may provide an initial classification; when omitted, the system assigns Routine.

purpose: Verify the behaviour stated in AFR-BA-030.
preconditions: Approved archival data has an authoritative classification and corresponding institute policy.
action_or_input: Evaluate the security and retention treatment for the authoritative classification.
expected_result: The system applies security and retention rules according to the authoritative data classification.

purpose: Verify the behaviour stated in AFR-BA-031.
preconditions: An approved request is authoritatively classified Sensitive and IT Security is identifiable.
action_or_input: Assign Sensitive as the authoritative classification and inspect the next review destination.
expected_result: The Sensitive request is routed to the IT Security Team for encryption configuration.

purpose: Verify the behaviour stated in AFR-BA-032.
preconditions: Data is classified Sensitive and an authorized IT Security actor is available.
action_or_input: Have IT Security configure encryption for the Sensitive data.
expected_result: The IT Security Team can configure encryption for data classified Sensitive.

purpose: Verify the behaviour stated in AFR-BA-033.
preconditions: Sensitive-data encryption has been configured successfully.
action_or_input: Complete encryption configuration and inspect archive creation and the recorded outcome.
expected_result: The system creates the encrypted archive and records the outcome after encryption is configured.

purpose: Verify the behaviour stated in AFR-BA-034.
preconditions: Sensitive data is ready for encryption and both storage and transfer paths can be inspected.
action_or_input: Encrypt the Sensitive data and inspect encryption used at rest and in transit.
expected_result: AES-256 encryption is used both at rest and in transit for Sensitive data.

purpose: Verify the behaviour stated in AFR-BA-035.
preconditions: A secure archival request exists and can be moved through its processing stages.
action_or_input: As the requester, retrieve the request status/history at successive processing stages.
expected_result: The user can track the status and history of the secure archival request throughout processing.

purpose: Verify the behaviour stated in AFR-BA-036.
preconditions: A secure archival request can be submitted and then approved or rejected.
action_or_input: Submit a request and exercise the approval and rejection decision stages; inspect notifications.
expected_result: A submission confirmation and decision notifications are sent at the relevant approval/rejection stages.

purpose: Verify the behaviour stated in AFR-BA-037.
preconditions: An offline request for extended storage of Sensitive research data has been received from an authority; a Super Admin is available.
action_or_input: Perform the special archival operation as Super Admin for the Sensitive research data.
expected_result: The Super Admin can perform the special archival operation when the offline request condition is met.

purpose: Verify the behaviour stated in AFR-BA-038.
preconditions: A special archival operation is available and a Super Admin actor is available.
action_or_input: Perform the special archival operation as the Super Admin.
expected_result: The Super Admin is permitted to perform the special archival operation in BADMS.

purpose: Verify the behaviour stated in AFR-BA-039.
preconditions: A Super Admin can perform a valid special archival operation.
action_or_input: Perform the special archival operation and inspect its outcome record and audit trail.
expected_result: The operation outcome and corresponding audit event are recorded.

purpose: Verify the behaviour stated in AFR-BA-040.
preconditions: An archived dataset is available to a user who can submit a restoration request.
action_or_input: Submit a request to restore the archived data.
expected_result: The user can request restoration of archived data.

purpose: Verify the behaviour stated in AFR-BA-041.
preconditions: A Sensitive archive and a restoration request are available, and SysAdmin approval has been recorded.
action_or_input: Proceed with restoration of the Sensitive data after the SysAdmin approval is recorded.
expected_result: Sensitive restoration proceeds only after the required SysAdmin approval.

purpose: Verify the behaviour stated in AFR-BA-042.
preconditions: A non-Sensitive archived dataset is available for restoration.
action_or_input: Request and execute restoration of the non-Sensitive dataset through the standard procedure.
expected_result: The system supports restoration of non-Sensitive archived data through the standard restoration procedure.

purpose: Verify the behaviour stated in AFR-BA-043.
preconditions: A restoration request exists and has progressed through at least one status change.
action_or_input: Retrieve the restoration-request status as the user.
expected_result: The user can track the restoration-request status.

purpose: Verify the behaviour stated in AFR-BA-045.
preconditions: A user’s storage quota is full and the user is authenticated.
action_or_input: Submit a storage-extension request while the quota is full.
expected_result: The user is allowed to submit a storage-extension request when the quota is full.

purpose: Verify the behaviour stated in AFR-BA-046.
preconditions: A storage-extension request and the user’s current storage-usage/quota data are available.
action_or_input: Submit a storage-extension request and inspect the validation against current storage usage.
expected_result: The system validates the request against the user’s current storage usage.

purpose: Verify the behaviour stated in AFR-BA-047.
preconditions: A valid storage-extension request exists and the requester’s HoD is identifiable.
action_or_input: Submit the valid request and inspect its review routing.
expected_result: The valid storage-extension request is routed to the user’s HoD for review.

purpose: Verify the behaviour stated in AFR-BA-048.
preconditions: A storage-extension request, its attachments and relevant infrastructure/policy information are available to the HoD.
action_or_input: Open the request as the HoD and inspect the review information presented.
expected_result: The HoD can review request details, attachments, available storage infrastructure, departmental policy and the user’s justification.

purpose: Verify the behaviour stated in AFR-BA-049.
preconditions: A storage-extension request is submitted and awaiting its HoD decision.
action_or_input: Record approval in one run and rejection in another; inspect the recorded decisions.
expected_result: The HoD can approve or reject the storage-extension request and the decision is recorded.

purpose: Verify the behaviour stated in AFR-BA-051.
preconditions: Storage usage records exist for all test users.
action_or_input: Run the storage-threshold monitoring operation and inspect users evaluated.
expected_result: The system monitors storage thresholds for all users.

purpose: Verify the behaviour stated in AFR-BA-052.
preconditions: Available storage infrastructure and a storage-extension request with a requested amount are represented.
action_or_input: Validate requested storage against available infrastructure, including a request that exceeds available capacity.
expected_result: The system validates requested storage against available infrastructure and detects when the requested extension exceeds it.

purpose: Verify the behaviour stated in AFR-BA-053.
preconditions: A Super Admin actor is available and institution-wide schedule/default policy inputs are defined.
action_or_input: Define an institution-wide global backup schedule and default backup policy as Super Admin.
expected_result: The Super Admin can define institution-wide global backup schedules and default backup policies.

purpose: Verify the behaviour stated in AFR-BA-054.
preconditions: A global schedule exists for relevant datasets and no valid local override exists for the dataset under test.
action_or_input: Resolve the effective schedule for the dataset.
expected_result: The global schedule is applied to the relevant system/dataset when no valid local override exists.

purpose: Verify the behaviour stated in AFR-BA-055.
preconditions: A global schedule and a valid local schedule exist for the same specific dataset.
action_or_input: Resolve the effective schedule for that dataset.
expected_result: The local schedule overrides the institution-wide global schedule for that dataset.

purpose: Verify the behaviour stated in AFR-BA-056.
preconditions: Institute-defined retention rules exist for the supported data classifications.
action_or_input: Evaluate retention for archived data using its classification.
expected_result: The system enforces institute-defined retention rules according to data classification.

purpose: Verify the behaviour stated in AFR-BA-057.
preconditions: A backup can be marked Failed and a SysAdmin alert destination is available; time can be measured.
action_or_input: Mark a backup Failed and measure the time until the SysAdmin alert is issued.
expected_result: The SysAdmin receives the alert within five minutes of the backup being marked Failed.

purpose: Verify the behaviour stated in AFR-BA-058.
preconditions: A backup history can be prepared with consecutive failure counts.
action_or_input: Record three consecutive backup failures and inspect escalation.
expected_result: The system escalates to the Director of IT when three consecutive backup failures occur.

purpose: Verify the behaviour stated in AFR-BA-059.
preconditions: Backup creation can complete successfully and can fail in separate runs; notification recipients are configured.
action_or_input: Run backup creation and inspect creation-status, completion and failure notifications.
expected_result: The system issues backup creation-status and completion notifications, including failure alerts to the SysAdmin.

purpose: Verify the behaviour stated in AFR-BA-060.
preconditions: A requester can submit a storage-extension request and a HoD can decide it.
action_or_input: Submit the request, then record approval and rejection outcomes in separate runs; inspect requester notifications.
expected_result: The requester is notified on submission and when the HoD approves or rejects the request.

purpose: Verify the behaviour stated in AFR-BA-061.
preconditions: User, administrative, system and security events can be generated.
action_or_input: Generate each stated category of event and inspect its audit record fields.
expected_result: Audit logs are maintained for all four stated event categories and include timestamps, actor identifiers, actions and outcomes.

purpose: Verify the behaviour stated in AFR-BA-062.
preconditions: Audit logs and activity-history records exist; a SysAdmin actor is available.
action_or_input: Request audit logs and activity histories as SysAdmin.
expected_result: The SysAdmin can view audit logs and activity histories.

purpose: Verify the behaviour stated in AFR-BA-063.
preconditions: Data-activity events including an unauthorized-access event and security-related reports exist; an IT Security actor is available.
action_or_input: Review the data-activity logs and security-related reports as IT Security.
expected_result: The IT Security Team can audit data-activity logs for unauthorized access and review security-related reports.

purpose: Verify the behaviour stated in AFR-BA-064.
preconditions: Operational reports exist for at least two departments; a HoD actor has a known department.
action_or_input: Request operational reports as the HoD.
expected_result: The HoD can view operational reports relevant to the HoD’s own department.

purpose: Verify the behaviour stated in AFR-BA-065.
preconditions: Backup operations and their recorded status/history are available.
action_or_input: Open the operational visibility/reporting view used for backup monitoring and compliance verification.
expected_result: The system provides operational visibility into backup operations for monitoring and compliance verification.

purpose: Verify the behaviour stated in AFR-BA-066.
preconditions: The central IAM/RBAC administration facility is available and an authorized IT Security actor is provisioned.
action_or_input: Use the role-based access-control facility as IT Security to manage user permissions.
expected_result: The IT Security Team can manage user permissions through RBAC.

purpose: Verify the behaviour stated in AFR-BA-067.
preconditions: The security-policy facility is available and an authorized IT Security actor is provisioned.
action_or_input: Define and enforce policies governing encryption, access and security controls as IT Security.
expected_result: The IT Security Team can define and enforce the stated security policies.

purpose: Verify the behaviour stated in AFR-BA-068.
preconditions: HoD, SysAdmin, Super Admin and IT Security actors exist across at least two departments.
action_or_input: Exercise HoD actions on own- and other-department requests and representative technical/security actions as the named roles.
expected_result: HoDs act only on requests from their departments, and technical/security responsibilities remain assigned to the authorized roles.

source_id: AFR-BA-001 — actor outside SysAdmin and Super Admin roles
purpose: Verify actor outside SysAdmin and Super Admin roles.
preconditions: An actor does not have the SysAdmin or Super Admin role. A manual backup target is available.
action_or_input: Attempt to trigger a manual backup as an actor outside the two roles named by AFR-BA-001.
expected_result: The actor is not allowed to trigger the manual backup; no backup is created.

purpose: Verify HoD outside requester department.
preconditions: A secure archival request belongs to Department A. The acting HoD belongs to Department B.
action_or_input: Attempt to approve or reject the Department A request as the Department B HoD.
expected_result: The Department B HoD is not permitted to decide the Department A request.

purpose: Verify invalid or conflicting schedule.
preconditions: A valid schedule and a proposed schedule that conflicts with it are available.
action_or_input: Submit the schedule configuration that conflicts with the existing schedule.
expected_result: The conflicting schedule configuration is rejected and is not applied.

purpose: Verify validation failure path.
preconditions: An archival request submission has otherwise valid information, but the storage-quota validation fails.
action_or_input: Submit the archival request under the quota condition that causes validation to fail; inspect feedback and request state.
expected_result: The system displays validation errors and makes no request-state change.

source_id: AFR-BA-038 — actor other than Super Admin
purpose: Verify actor other than Super Admin.
preconditions: A special archival operation is available to be performed.
action_or_input: Attempt the special archival operation as an actor who is not the Super Admin.
expected_result: The operation is refused for that actor; the special archival operation is not performed.

source_id: AFR-BA-041 — Sensitive restoration before SysAdmin approval
purpose: Verify Sensitive restoration before SysAdmin approval.
preconditions: An archive is classified Sensitive and a restoration request is pending without SysAdmin approval.
action_or_input: Attempt to proceed with restoration before SysAdmin approval is recorded.
expected_result: Restoration does not proceed until the required SysAdmin approval is recorded.
